metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working with coding agents: skills, agents, commands, and hooks built on harness-engineering practices.

plugins.name: feedback-loop
plugins.description: Reviews past sessions for where the agent struggled, was corrected or needed things handed to it, and proposes the environment fix for each.

plugins.name: conventions
plugins.description: House conventions for building what an agent reads: how to write a skill, and how to design skills, agent definitions, commands, hooks and prompts for a capable model.

plugins.name: repo
plugins.description: Makes a repo legible to the agent: a short CLAUDE.md map, a run skill, verification skills, hooks and scoped permissions, written into the repo, or kept local when the repo shouldn't carry them.

plugins.name: tasks
plugins.description: A task workflow for coding agents, on beads (bd): one focus per session with plans, gates and handoffs in each repo, plus a standup repo that reports across repos, triages asks and routes email into tasks.
